plainTranslation: Their Moon in your 2nd house: they feel emotionally tied to your security and resources; comfort, money, and stability carry feeling between you. Failure mode: emotional safety measured in material terms. Build steadiness; don't let comfort stand in for closeness.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
